content: LLM trading bots: enforce structured JSON via Pydantic models; populate a reason field for an auditable trail; log every decision to JSONL (signal_log.jsonl) capturing what the model saw and why. Confidence levels (low/med/high) standard. Key insight: LLMs are most effective as evaluation/reasoning/sanity-check steps AFTER signals fire, not as the sole signal generator. System prompt wording materially changes behavior; few-shot is non-deterministic, fine-tuning/RAG needed for repeatable output.
